claims.citation: New York Herald, 21 August 1866, p. 5, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Britannia (Br), Laird, Glasgow, Aug 3, and
Moville 5th, with mdse and 452 passengers, to F Macdonald
& Co. Aug 8, lat 62[?] 46, lon 20 08, passed ship Hibernia, hence
for Glasgow; 12th, lat 51 29, lon 39 35[?] passed H B M steamers
Terrible and Albany, standing S; same day, lat 51 22[?], lon
39 52, steamship Great Eastern and accompanying steamers,
standing E.
